attackers_goals: Attackers aim to get persistence to continue operating even after a reboot.
description: Execution of an uncommon process with a local/domain user SID at an early startup stage by Windows system binary may be an indication of a persistent mechanism on boot that is being actively abused.
investigative_actions: Check if the Causality Group Owner (CGO) has a related persistence mechanism that may have been abused by an attacker.
